cases.title: Rules list opens from Setup › Automation › Workflow Rules; columns Name · Module · Departments · Trigger · Mode · Actions · Status · Updated
cases.expected: Page and every column render; the 4+ teammate rules list correctly

cases.title: Search rules by part of a name, by a name in another case, and by a string with no match
cases.expected: Matching rows only; "No matching rules" empty state

cases.title: Module filter (All modules / Tickets / other Desk modules) and Department filter
cases.expected: List narrows correctly; counts match the API

cases.title: Active / Inactive tabs (status filter) and their counts
cases.expected: Each tab shows only rules in that state

cases.title: Trigger column text for every trigger kind (On Create … Happiness Rating: Good, Date-Field Relative with offset and "· business hours")
cases.expected: Summary text names the trigger and its options

cases.title: Actions column counts instant + scheduled actions of every rule
cases.expected: Count = total actions of the rule

cases.title: Row menu: Edit · Activate/Deactivate · Test rule · Delete
cases.expected: Each item works; Deactivate stops runs at once

cases.title: Bulk select + Delete (n) with the confirm text about the Recycle Bin and scheduled actions
cases.expected: Rules move to the Recycle Bin; their pending scheduled actions are cancelled

cases.title: Reorder rules (drag) and reload
cases.expected: Order persists (PUT /workflow/rules/reorder); execution follows the order

cases.title: Rule-limit display: "n of max rules used in this department" and New Rule disabled at the cap
cases.expected: Cap message from caps.rules; New Rule disabled
cases.needs: API-created filler rules in a QA department

cases.title: New Rule wizard: Module, Rule Name, Description, Layout (All / one), Departments (All / selected), "When should this rule be executed?" then Next
cases.expected: Wizard opens the editor with the chosen values

cases.title: Wizard validation: no module, no name, name 255+ chars, name with only spaces
cases.expected: Inline messages; nothing saved

cases.title: Wizard: choose Ticket Event then switch module to a non-ticket module
cases.expected: Ticket Event resets to Record Action (only Tickets offer ticket events)

cases.title: Wizard trigger offer for non-ticket Desk modules (Contacts, Accounts, Tasks…)
cases.expected: Only Record Action and Date-Time; no Ticket Event, no Record Note, no Score

cases.title: Workflow settings page: sender name and sender email; default hint; invalid email; braces/line breaks; conflict reload
cases.expected: Saved sender is used by workflow emails within a minute; validation messages match
cases.needs: Mailbox to see the From line

cases.title: Rule limits panel in Workflow settings (rules per module+department, actions per rule, conditions per rule)
cases.expected: Shows provider limits; matches the real caps hit in M group

cases.title: On Create fires for a ticket created from the agent UI
cases.expected: Action runs once; execution history "Fired"

cases.title: On Create fires for each ticket source: API, email-in, Help Center portal, web form, import, CRM integration
cases.expected: Fires once per new ticket from every source

cases.title: On Create does NOT fire on edit, comment, reply or delete
cases.expected: No execution row for those events

cases.title: On Edit fires on field edit from ticket detail, list inline edit, bulk edit, macro, API PATCH
cases.expected: Fires once per save

cases.title: On Edit does NOT fire on create (old NDC-2205)
cases.expected: No run on create

cases.title: On Edit with a save that changes nothing (same value)
cases.expected: Rule does not fire, or fires per Zoho behaviour (record which)

cases.title: On Create or Edit fires on both and only once per save
cases.expected: One run on create, one per edit

cases.title: On Delete fires when a ticket is deleted (single, bulk, API)
cases.expected: Allowed async action runs with the deleted ticket values

cases.title: On Delete does NOT fire on restore from Recycle Bin, on spam, on merge
cases.expected: No run (record Zoho for merge)

cases.title: Edits made by the workflow itself (Field Update) do not re-fire On Edit rules in an endless loop
cases.expected: Loop guard stops; history shows a finite chain

cases.title: Status change to Closed / reopen counts as Edit
cases.expected: Edit rules fire on close and on reopen

cases.title: Blueprint transition, SLA escalation and assignment-rule owner change: do they fire Edit rules?
cases.expected: Behaviour recorded and compared with Zoho

cases.title: Field Changed, one watch field (Subject): fires only when Subject changes
cases.expected: Fires on Subject edit; not on other edits

cases.title: Field Changed on each field data type: text, picklist (Status, Priority), user (Owner), lookup (Contact), date, number, checkbox, multi-select, Department, Team
cases.expected: Fires on change of that field only

cases.title: "+ Add a field": 2 and 3 watch fields with "Any of these fields changes"
cases.expected: Fires when any one of them changes

cases.title: "All of these fields change in the same save" with 2 fields
cases.expected: Fires only when both change in one save; not when one changes

cases.title: Maximum number of watch fields; the same field cannot be picked twice
cases.expected: Picker hides fields already chosen; cap respected

cases.title: "Also run when a record is created" on / off
cases.expected: On: fires on every new ticket matching criteria, later only on field change. Off: never on create

cases.title: Field Changed does not fire on create when "Also run on create" is off (old NDC-2205)
cases.expected: No run on create

cases.title: Field Changed + condition "changed from X" / "changed to Y" (API ChangedFrom/ChangedTo)
cases.expected: Fires only for that transition

cases.title: Field cleared (value → empty) and set (empty → value)
cases.expected: Both count as a change

cases.title: Watch field later deleted from Modules & Fields
cases.expected: Editor shows "(unknown field)"; rule does not crash runs
cases.needs: QA custom field on QA layout

cases.title: Date field picker lists every date / date-time ticket field (Due date, custom date, custom date-time)
cases.expected: All date fields offered; non-date fields not offered

cases.title: Run N minutes before the date (elapsed time)
cases.expected: Action runs at date − N min (±1 min)

cases.title: Run N minutes after the date

cases.title: Hours and Days units, before and after
cases.expected: Offset converts correctly (seconds stored)

cases.title: Offset 0 (at the date)
cases.expected: Runs at the date, or the UI blocks 0 (record)

cases.title: Counting = Business hours (units only Minutes / Hours)
cases.expected: Offset counts only open hours; Days not offered

cases.title: Business-hours counting with no business hours set
cases.expected: Falls back to elapsed time (as the hint says)

cases.title: Date moved later / earlier after the schedule was made

cases.title: Date cleared before the run time
cases.expected: Scheduled run is cancelled

cases.title: Ticket deleted before the run time

cases.title: Module without date fields
cases.expected: "This module has no date fields, so it cannot use a date trigger."
